design_decisions.choice: Perform Group G only after M190, M191, and M192 are complete and green; do not absorb behavioral remediation from Groups A-F into cleanup.
design_decisions.rationale: Architecture and comment cleanup must be based on the corrected behavior and remain separately reviewable.

design_decisions.choice: Keep crates/mp/src/app.rs below the documented 400-line limit by extracting command-family routing into focused modules behind a small top-level dispatch interface; enforce the intentional line-count and dependency boundary with an architecture test.
design_decisions.rationale: A small dispatcher makes command ownership visible and prevents app.rs from becoming a cross-family coupling point.

design_decisions.choice: Extend Group B's bounded-loader seam instead of introducing another loader abstraction, and expose one active-schema filename registry consumed by dispatch and oracle parity coverage.
design_decisions.rationale: One loader and one schema registry prevent policy and coverage drift.

design_decisions.choice: Move tests that only spawn mp from mp-oracle into crates/mp/tests using the package-provided binary path; retain only true jsonschema parity tests in mp-oracle; remove pass-through helpers only when they own no invariant, policy, or test seam.
design_decisions.rationale: Test ownership should follow the behavior under test, while useful seams must not be flattened indiscriminately.

design_decisions.choice: Use canonical stable-ID visible projections for every filtered Raul list, and route TUI mutations through module-owned operations that preserve cursor anchoring, dirty/version state, cache invalidation, and Watch preflight invalidation.
design_decisions.rationale: Rendering and actions must target the same object, and every mutation must update all dependent state.

design_decisions.choice: Move Watch log tailing into polling state, retain a bounded cached tail, and make render functions consume memory only; prove the boundary with a counting or poison reader test.
design_decisions.rationale: Synchronous filesystem reads in rendering can stall frames and hide I/O ownership.

design_decisions.choice: Represent terminal setup as staged RAII transitions Normal to Raw to Alternate to Mouse; teardown unwinds only completed stages in reverse order, with injected failure after every setup operation.
design_decisions.rationale: Partial initialization must restore the terminal without running teardown for stages that never completed.

design_decisions.choice: Run every mutable fixture test from a temporary copy through one shared fixture helper and assert the tracked fixture source tree is byte-for-byte unchanged, including no lock, activity, staging, or recovery artifacts.
design_decisions.rationale: Tests must not mutate repository fixtures or make later test outcomes order-dependent.

design_decisions.choice: Apply the targeted KEEP, SHORTEN, REMOVE, and CORRECT-or-MOVE inventory file by file; retain present-tense safety and invariant contracts, move chronology to durable history, and reject comment-only diffs that alter executable lines.
design_decisions.rationale: Comments should explain current non-obvious contracts without obscuring behavioral changes or preserving stale implementation history.

findings.description:
Group G item 10 / AC-07 require every mutable fixture test to run from a temporary copy through one shared helper and assert the tracked source tree remains byte-identical (no .mp-write.lock / activity.json / txn artifacts).

Only `run_validate_fixture` in crates/mp/tests/common/mod.rs implements that full contract (copy + pre/post snapshot). Dozens of mutable suites still ship local `cp_r` / `copy_fixture` helpers (fragment_*, backlog_*, verification_preflight, list_projection_flags, sort_regression, lifecycle_migration, etc.) with no shared helper and no source-tree assertion. AC-07's verification command (`suite_validate` filtered to `/fixture/`) only exercises the validate_fixture path, so a green AC-07 does not prove the stated criterion (L1).

Remediation: consolidate mutable fixture setup onto one helper that snapshots/asserts source immutability, migrate the local copy helpers, and widen AC-07 verification accordingly.

findings.summary: AC-07 fixture isolation not fully delivered

findings.description:
AC-08 requires the KEEP inventory to remain documented, present-tense, and free of historical tags. The targeted KEEP contracts for mp-model legacy-done and empty-phase semantics still embed milestone/finding provenance tags (e.g. `legacy_execution_status_to_lifecycle` rustdoc references M100; `has_open_self_findings` rustdoc references M101/M125 chronology).

code-review-fixes.txt comment procedure step 4 also requires stripping M*/F* tags from production comments once the work has landed, preserving provenance in git/ADRs/tests instead. Targeted REMOVE/CORRECT stale-claim items appear addressed, but KEEP (and adjacent SHORTEN surfaces in activity/complete/io) were not finished to the AC-08 bar.

Remediation: rewrite the KEEP inventory comments to state the current invariant only, without M*/F* tags or incident chronology; re-scan the SHORTEN inventory files the same way.
